caption: "mu stock" — 20,000+ searches today. Micron just had the biggest quarter in its history.

Why: On September 30, Micron reported record quarterly revenue of $54.23 billion, up 379% in a year, driven by demand from AI data centers. Its profit for the quarter, $37.7 billion, was more than its entire revenue for fiscal 2025. It expects about $61.5 billion next quarter.

What most people don't know: Micron quit selling memory to ordinary shoppers. In December 2025 it shut down Crucial, its 29-year-old consumer brand, to send supply to data centers. Shipments ended in February.
Very simply put: AI got the memory. Shoppers got the bill.

slides.headline: Micron's profit in 3 months beat all its sales last *year*.
slides.sub: 10 things most people don't know about Micron's record quarter, searched 20,000+ times in the US today.
